title: CCv3 State of Rework — Fable-5 Deep Review, 2026-06-27

tier1.what: CCv3 is a self-improving Claude Code substrate: six integrated pillars (Memory / Hooks / Agents / PageIndex / Workflows / Braintrust) on a WS-2 code-intelligence substrate (codegraph L3 specialist → /code-intel facade L4 → L2 context bus) that compounds a Claude instance's effectiveness across sessions via persistent BGE-vector semantic memory, TypeScript lifecycle-event hooks compiled to ESM, specialized sub-agent delegation via the Task tool, Ralph/Maestro workflow orchestration, and Braintrust telemetry with LLM judges.
tier1.why: The Fable-5 deep review (WF-0 harvest → WF-1 discovery → WF-2 WF-3 verify+synthesis at SHA 86b8f60) surfaced 190 confirmed findings (S0:3, S1:41, S2:108, S3:38) plus a Codex gpt-5.5@xhigh cross-model pass (184 independently corroborated, 6 codex-only additional findings, 2 S1→S2 Codex downgrades). Elegance verdict: mixed. The SQL layer, secret handling, path-traversal defenses, and L3 boundary/bus design are cleared by the D5b coverage manifest; the enforcement and intelligence periphery is largely dead or mis-wired. Three structural seams are active today: (1) the entire agent safety+verification chain (12 hooks) never fires because all are registered under matcher 'Agent' while the live Claude Code tool emits 'Task'; (2) the context bus symbol layer is write-dead because SubagentStop has zero registrations anywhere; (3) seven competing getSessionId implementations produce non-joinable telemetry, causing 60.7% corr-null on intel-bus rows. The dominant failure pattern is registration/wiring drift plus consolidatable duplication — prune-and-rewire on a sound core, not fundamental over-design.
tier1.where: The elegant end-state: a single-writer context bus where SubagentStop commits sub-agent proposed_bus_updates so cross-agent context is never silently dropped; a lean UserPromptSubmit hot-path with a resident recall daemon eliminating the 22-32s 13-spawn serial wall; one canonical getSessionId, one storeLearning(argv) spawnSync helper across all call sites, one injectRecall() sanitizer before any archival content reaches model context; behavior evidence-locked via §9 facade-bypass counts in intel-bus.jsonl so the C.5 deny-flip gate triggers only after ≥80% adoption is measured in actual telemetry; WRRF source weights recalibrated from 30 days of bus-wrrf.jsonl rather than held as educated guesses; and no always-loaded doc surface asserting enforcement that has never fired.
tier1.headline_verdict: Clean spine, baroque edges: 190 findings, three dead safety chains, one write-dead bus, a 22-32s hot-path tax — all rewire-in-place on a sound core.

sections.heading: Current State — Six Pillars + WS-2 Substrate
sections.body_html:
Health legend: sound = correct and wired; honing = functional with open findings; gap = unregistered, dead matcher, or missing committer. SHA 86b8f60.

  • Memory — honing. BGE-large-en-v1.5 (1024-dim), Postgres pgvector, hybrid RRF recall. Hit rate 27.4% across 281 recall events. Three co-dominant suppressors: D3b-01 (HYBRID_FLOOR=0.01 applied after a decay multiplier — mathematical exclusion of most corpus even in hybrid mode); D3b-02 (plainto_tsquery AND-semantics over full prompt → FTS arm near-always empty → hybrid degrades to vector-only); D2c-01 (24.6% of recall queries are <task-notification> XML blobs — no machine-content guard in extractIntent). Sub-agent recall: 0 of 281 rows — agent layer is fully memory-blind. QW-01 shipped (commit 1788211): store_learning.py now uses spawnSync argv, closing the shell-injection root cause of the daily opc/400 junk-file flood.
  • Hooks — gap. 111 TypeScript source files compiled to 111 dist MJS; 76 registered, 35 never fire. CRITICAL D2b-01/D10c-02: the entire agent safety+verification chain — agent-model-guard, no-haiku-enforcer, maestro-enforcer, navigator-validate, task-router (PreToolUse) plus agent-error-capture, agent-verification, ralph-task-monitor (PostToolUse) — all registered under matcher 'Agent' while the live tool emits 'Task'. Zero pre-spawn guard, zero post-spawn verification on every subagent spawn. UserPromptSubmit hot-path serializes 13 process spawns, 22-32s worst-case. epistemic-reminder.ts reads input.tool not input.tool_name — never fires despite claim-verification.md asserting it runs after every Grep (D2d-03).
  • Agents — honing. 36 .md definition files; 16 companion .json files are an obsolete Agentica schema — never executed by Claude Code (D7c-01). 30 of 36 agents have never appeared in recall rows, including oracle, debug-agent, sleuth, architect, phoenix, arbiter. Activity is dominated by the review pipeline: codex-adversary + critic + plan-reviewer account for ~50% of 78 total agent-recall rows. The spawn-side guard chain is dead per D2b-01.
  • PageIndex — honing. Per-prompt hook (pageindex-navigator.ts) disabled 2026-06-01 after telemetry showed 0/16 query-hits at 1.8–15.8s/prompt latency. Homegrown ~4.8K LOC system and Postgres pageindex_* tables intact; pageindex-watch.ts still fires on Write|Edit. Now on-demand-only via deliberate CLI invocation.
  • Workflows — honing. Ralph core delegation loop works (Task tool, not guarded by dead Agent-matcher hooks). ralph-task-monitor dead (PostToolUse/Agent). plan-to-ralph-enforcer and plan-exit-tracker both active. Maestro: maestro-enforcer has never fired (Agent matcher dead — D10c-03). RULES.md asserts C:10 blocking; that assertion is false.
  • Braintrust — honing. 4 active await emitBraintrustScore() calls across 4 TS files (emit-invariant enforced by audit-braintrust-emits.sh). Score dimensions: hook_health_ratio, memory_recall_relevance, memory_recall_hit, skill_trigger_accuracy, tool_call_success (Python). agent_task_success dead (PostToolUse/Agent matcher). 7 competing getSessionId implementations, 4 distinct fallback semantics → corr-null on 60.7% of intel-bus rows (D7d-01).

WS-2 Substrate:

  • Context Bus L2 (shared/context-bus.ts) — partial. Read path functional; intent+turn writes active (bus-session-populator, bus-tool-populator). CRITICAL: focus_symbols and recent_findings have zero production writers — SubagentStop has 0 registrations across repo + active + template (D10c-01). Every proposed_bus_updates from the codegraph facade is computed and silently dropped. Bus lock cap leaky: 200ms design vs 2293ms observed; 158 slow / 14 dropped writes (D4a-02). Only 3 of 8 files_in_play roles have writers.
  • /code-intel Facade L4 (scripts/code-intel.mjs, 1130 lines) — partial. All subcommands routable; codegraph wired Phase C.2. In-facade routing: 45.7% vs ≥80% C.5 gate (D9-03). code-intel-enforcer default-OFF, wrong matcher (Bash|mcp__serena vs actual tool names), logs zero events to intel-bus — §9 deny-gate denominator has no data (D1A-004). tldr-cli.md (always in context per CLAUDE.md Operational Rules) still routes symbol search to TLDR directly, contradicting the boundary contract; Phase B.5 instruction-surface patching never executed (D1A-003). bus_id unknown on 100/125 facade rows (D1b-05).
  • codegraph L3 (@colbymchenry/codegraph@0.9.9) — live, Phase C.2. SQLite WAL, .codegraph/codegraph.db. Platform contract C.1: 12/12 assertions GREEN on Windows 11 / Node 24.4.1. Cold index 9.0s; warm query 2.85s (Node+WASM cold-start dominated, not query work). Facade median latency ~62s — ensureFresh spawns one full codegraph process per dirty/untracked file with no source filter (documented 3-4s; actual 16-88s range, D4b-01). Incremental sync cross-file edge orphaning (C.1 finding #4): after callee-file edit, unchanged caller files not re-parsed → who-calls under-reports. Serena escalation hint emitted on empty/alias-prone results as mitigation.

sections.heading: What We're Adjusting — Four Backlog Tiers
sections.body_html:
Review pipeline: WF-0 (harvest) → WF-1 (248 discovered) → WF-2 (190 CONFIRM / 48 DOWNGRADE / 10 KILL) → WF-3 (synthesis + Codex cross-model pass). Codex independently corroborated 184/190; 6 findings unique to Codex beyond the confirmed 190 set.

Wave 0 — S0 Critical (all shipped):

  • QW-01 (commit 1788211): store_learning.py execSync shell→spawnSync argv. Closes D5a-01/D2c-04/D2d-06/D3a-01. Fixes shell-injection root cause plus daily opc/400 junk-file flood from 4 hooks building store commands via string concatenation.
  • QW-02 (commit 89c9e5e): smart-search-router hardcoded /tmp handshake → os.tmpdir(). Closes D2b-05. BGE daemon rendezvous now cross-platform correct.
  • QW-03 (commit f7f3eba): ROADMAP contamination guard negative-stopword allowlist → positive own-project identity + own-plan selection. Closes D2d-01/D2d-02/D2F-03. Addresses Session-9 incident (Salesforce goal written to this ROADMAP).

Wave 1 — S1 Quick-Wins (9 items; most independent):

  • QW-04: Matcher split-brain — change 'Agent'→'Task' across all 3 settings surfaces (repo + active + template) for the 12-hook agent safety+verification chain. Must be last in Wave 1 (re-enabling agent-error-capture exposes D2d-07/D2d-06 bugs before they are fixed; flip guard/verify hooks first, inject hooks last, each verified step). D2b-01/D10c-02/D8a-01/D10c-04.
  • QW-05: epistemic-reminder.ts:44 — change input.tool→input.tool_name. One-word field fix reviving the claim-verification Grep guard. D2d-03.
  • QW-06: Memory recall math — recompute/raise HYBRID_FLOOR past the decay multiplier; switch plainto_tsquery→websearch_to_tsquery in memory_service_pg.py + recall_learnings.py. Two constants + one function. D3b-01/D3b-02/D3b-08.
  • QW-07: Intent-pollution filter — <task-notification> XML machine-content guard + length cap upstream of extractIntent; fix expandGitQuery lower.includes('pr') substring collision + XML swallow. Single chokepoint kills 24.6% pollution feeding every recall+bus consumer. D2c-01/D3b-05/D3c-04 cluster.
  • QW-08: Ghost skill cleanup — remove 26 arscontexta-* + 2 archived entries from skill-rules.json (28 ghost registrations carrying ~85 live keywords that trigger 'SKILL ACTIVATION CHECK' for nonexistent skills). D7b-01/D7b-02/D7b-07/D8c-06.
  • QW-09: Defuse hook-auto-execute.md — remove 'execute that command via Bash without asking' / 'do NOT ask user permission' language tied to deny-reason commands. Named 'Routing to' redirects are dead (Agent split-brain); only live denier is smart-search-router whose messages suggest banned patterns. D8a-02.
  • QW-10: Stray artifact quarantine — 11 git-tracked tmpclaude-*-cwd files (39-byte cwd-capture artifacts with no .gitignore guard) + .ssr_slice.txt (operator confirm required — untracked review scratch). D1A-007/D2g-10/D7d-06.
  • QW-11: post-edit-diagnostics — fix tsc .cmd shim invocation to node tsc.js (CVE-2024-27980 pattern); restore bus 'edited' write before early-return so every TS/JS edit records to bus. D2e-02/D2e-08.
  • QW-12: ROADMAP write-guard correctness — prd-roadmap-sync relatedness check before marking current goal complete; git-commit-roadmap cwd verification before recording commits. D2d-09/D2d-10/D2d-13.

Tier 2 — Structural Arcs (10 items; each needs own plan+premortem before implementation): ST-01 SubagentStop + bus symbol writer (write-dead focus_symbols); ST-02 7→1 session-id (prerequisite for SG-04 telemetry joinability); ST-03 UserPromptSubmit 13-spawn parallelization (prerequisite: ST-05 daemon); ST-04 codegraph facade 35-88s→budget (prerequisite for C.5 ≥80% gate); ST-05 resident recall daemon (prerequisite for ST-10); ST-06 permission layer redesign (precondition for injection fixes per Codex finding); ST-07 memory sanitizer 2→5 injectors; ST-08 Grep-path shell-injection argv-ify on smart-search-router + daemon-client; ST-09 bus lock + write-amplification hardening; ST-10 agent-recall-injector 0-for-78 fix (DELICATE — documented regression history; depends ST-05).

Tier 3 — Strategic Programs (4 items): SG-01 memory recall floor + corpus health SLO (follows QW-06/QW-07/ST-05); SG-02 3-way settings/template drift reconciliation + source-of-truth enforcement (18 hook registrations live in active but absent from tracked repo including package-install-guard and permission-auto-allow); SG-03 elegance/pruning program — collapse named duplication clusters, prune dead periphery via deletions backlog (owns operator-confirm DEL items); SG-04 telemetry joinability + intel-bus consumer Phases C.3/D/E (depends ST-02 + ST-01; re-examine codex-lift ROI: codex_only 77 > claude_only 49 in WF-1 slice but ROI undecidable without accepted/rejected disposition tracking).

Deletions (12 items): Safe-to-delete batch (DEL-01 tmpclaude files, DEL-03 test-build.ts, DEL-06 dead lib dupes, DEL-07 memory-client triple-dead + python3 caller, DEL-08 handoff-index + better-sqlite3 build dep) can batch in Wave 1 cleanup after per-item git grep static-ref-check. Higher-risk: DEL-09 (.claude/scripts/core mirror — remove from SYNC_DIRS first), DEL-05 (26 dead hook prototypes — two-step: relocate 6 live-misfiled shared libs first). Operator-confirm: DEL-02, DEL-11 (doc-coupled agents), DEL-12 (per-item-grep skills) defer to SG-03.

sections.heading: Elegance Gaps — Duplication Clusters, Dead Weight, Leaking Seams
sections.body_html:
Elegance verdict: mixed. Three dominant failure classes: (1) registration/wiring drift — hooks built but never wired, matchers referencing a dead tool name, docs asserting guarantees that never execute; (2) consolidatable duplication — the same logic re-implemented at 4-7 sites, each site independently diverging; (3) write-dead seams where a subsystem computes intelligence no consumer can receive.

Highest-leverage duplication clusters:

  • 7 session-id implementations with 4 distinct fallback semantics. Critical exacerbation: shared/index.ts barrel re-exports resource-reader.ts's ppid-scheme under the canonical name getSessionId — any future import { getSessionId } from './shared/index.js' silently gets the wrong implementation, propagating fragmentation to new code. Root contributor to corr-null 60.7% (D7d-01). Resolution: one canonical in shared/session-id.ts; getBusId() as its only composer; delete 4 private clones; fix barrel re-export.
  • 6 sync-script copies for one repo↔active relationship. Proof of failure already in repo: the 2026-06-01 clobber guard landed in scripts/sync-claude.sh but never in the .claude/scripts/ fork — one no-arg invocation recreates the clobber incident (D7d-02/D7d-03/D8a-03).
  • Python script tree triplication: canonical opc/scripts/core/recall_learnings.py (79,759 bytes), stale mirror .claude/scripts/core/recall_learnings.py (29,198 bytes — 4 months / ~50KB behind canonical, forward-synced to ~/.claude on every commit), bundled .claude/scripts/recall_learnings.py (6,968 bytes, different SQLite semantics). Stale fork plausibly interacts with the 27.4% memory-hit rate (D7d-04/D7d-05).
  • ~46MB Fourth presentation skill family across 3 overlapping skills: only fourth-presentation-suite is registered; 6.2MB PDF bit-identical across two skills; fourth-brand-guidelines ships a 5.6MB self-zip. All 46MB rides every repo→~/.claude sync and git history (D7b-03).
  • 4 store_learning.py call sites re-implementing shell-string interpolation: agent-error-capture.ts, user-confirmation-detector.ts, hook-error-pipeline.ts, session-end-extract.ts. QW-01 fixed the S0 surface via the same argv pattern. A single storeLearning(content, opts) helper with spawnSync argv removes the entire injection class at every site simultaneously — the fix that makes the security improvement non-bypassable (D5a-01/D2c-04/D2d-06/D3a-01).
  • Memory-recall context injectors: 5 archival_memory→context sites; WS-0.2 sanitizer applied to only 2. session-start-continuity.ts (RAW 600-char, SessionStart — decision-driving surface) and pre-plan-memory.ts (RAW 1500-char, EnterPlanMode — decision-driving surface) inject unsanitized recall output verbatim. Sanitizer rollout stopped at 2/5 (D5b-01/ST-07).

Dead weight (key categories):

  • 35/111 hook srcs never fire: 26 safe-dead unregistered prototypes (batch-deletable after git grep); 4 stale lib dupes in hooks/src/lib/ (must relocate to shared/, not delete — D7a-03/D2g-07); epistemic-reminder double-dead (wrong field + claim-verification.md asserts it live); test-build.ts one-line console.log stub committed by accident.
  • 30/36 agents never recalled; 16-file .json agent layer (obsolete Agentica schema, committed contamination of the agent dir, never executed — D7c-01); 2 hard-orphan agents (memory-extractor.md, braintrust-analyst.md) reachable only as prose in docs.
  • 28 ghost skill registrations in skill-rules.json: 26 arscontexta-* entries (removed plugin) + 2 archived skills, collectively carrying ~85 live keywords. Hook fires, injects 'SKILL ACTIVATION CHECK' instructing model to activate a skill that does not exist. arscontexta-remember's /remember keyword shadows the real remember skill.
  • 4 memory rule-stubs loaded verbatim into every global session's system prompt: agent-memory-recall.md, dynamic-recall.md, memory-usage-guidelines.md, proactive-learning.md. Each is a pure 'consolidated into memory skill — see X' redirect. Empirically confirmed: all 4 appear verbatim in review agent's loaded system prompt at non-trivial context cost for zero added behavior.

Leaking seams (6 identified):

  • Poison-then-inject chain: store-side writes un-sanitized agent/prompt text into archival_memory; read-side at session-start-continuity.ts (RAW 600-char, SessionStart) and pre-plan-memory.ts (RAW 1500-char, EnterPlanMode) renders any poisoned row verbatim on decision-driving surfaces. Codex cross-model finding: execSync always-shells, so the escaping approach is fundamentally wrong regardless of escaping quality. D5a-01/D5b-01.
  • Matcher split-brain: 'Agent' vs live 'Task' tool — kills the whole agent safety+verification chain. agent-error-capture.ts has an internal 'Task' name check in source creating a false-correctness signal (code looks right; hook never fires). Three doc surfaces (RULES.md, hook catalog, 2026-05-30 lean audit) assert C:10 Maestro blocking enforcement that has never executed. D2b-01/D10c-02/D10c-03.
  • Write-dead context bus: codegraph proposed_bus_updates computed on every facade call and dropped — SubagentStop has zero event registrations in repo + active + template. bus-focus.ts reads always-empty focus_symbols TODAY — existing degradation contributing nothing to recall, not a future gap. D1A-001/D1b-03/D4a-03/D4b-03.
  • Session-id fragmentation → telemetry non-joinability: 7 implementations; shared/index.ts barrel re-exports ppid-scheme under canonical name — new code importing from barrel gets wrong id. Mechanistic contributor to corr-null 60.7%, cross-subsystem state files non-joinable. D7d-01/D1b-05/D4a-01.
  • ROADMAP contamination guard: negative allowlist (unregistered foreign projects invisible); buildUnifiedContext re-extracts Current Focus without the guard (second contamination path); prd-roadmap-sync marks goal complete on any fully-checked tasks-*.md with no relatedness check; git-commit-roadmap records foreign-repo commits without verifying cwd. Session-9 empirical proof: Salesforce goal written to this ROADMAP 2026-06-06. D2d-01/D2d-02/D2F-03/D2d-09/D2d-10.
  • permission-auto-allow defeats the OS permission layer: active-only, no repo/template representation (GAP3-03 — one of 18 hooks missing from tracked repo). Auto-approves ALL Bash/Edit/Write/WebFetch, nullifying the OS permission dialog system-wide in normal mode. Codex cross-model: auto-allow removal is a PRECONDITION for injection fixes providing meaningful safety, not a parallel track. hook-auto-execute.md compounds by instructing model to run unprompted any bash found in a deny-reason. D2g-02/GAP3-01/D8a-02.

sections.heading: Data-Flow Reality — Traced End-to-End Paths, Seams, Races
sections.body_html:
Four traces grounded in live .claude/settings.json registration order and .claude/hooks/src/*.ts source logic at HEAD f7f3eba.

Trace 1: UserPromptSubmit → memory recall → bus read → context injection

12-step serialized chain: heartbeat (Postgres sessions heartbeat) → maestro-state-manager → guardrail-enforcer → skill-activation-prompt → bus-session-populator [WRITE — must precede step 6; ordering load-bearing for WS-2 B.3b/B.4a; mutateBus(bumpTurn + setIntent), 120-char sanitized prompt cap] → memory-awareness [readBus focus_symbols → isDaemonReady TCP probe → hybrid RRF or text-only FTS mode → parallel checkLocalMemory + checkDbMemory → mergeResults → applyFloor → Braintrust emit → MEMORY MATCH + SESSION FOCUS inject as additionalContext] → maestro-detector → user-confirmation-detector [RESOLUTION_SIGNALS → storeVictoryFromConfirmation via spawnSync argv post-QW-01] → ralph-watchdog → ralph-progress-inject → ralph-retry-reminder → braintrust_hooks.py (root span open/continue).

Critical seams: (1) bus WRITE (step 5) must precede bus READ (step 6) — reversed order gives memory-awareness stale intent, silently degrading recall bias; (2) isDaemonReady() reads ~/.claude/run/ccv3-embedding.json — daemon lifecycle is cross-session shared state where hot path meets BGE warm-up; (3) user-confirmation-detector reads smarter-everyday-state.json written by PostToolUse — state file read is unlocked, write uses writeStateWithLock.

Open races: D6a-01 — 13 serial spawns, 22-32s worst-case wall-clock before prompt answers; no parallelism despite memory-awareness docstring claiming parallel execution (main() runs 4 sequential subprocesses). D2c-01 — 24.6% of recall intents are <task-notification> XML blobs. D3b-01/D3b-02 — floor math + AND-semantics FTS jointly suppress hit rate to 27.4%.

Trace 2: Learning stored → L0 quality gate → store_learning.py → BGE embed → Postgres dedup

Three entry paths: agent-error-capture (PostToolUse/Agent — DEAD, matcher split-brain D10c-02; FAILED_APPROACH auto-capture pipeline is a ghost; every sub-agent error goes unrecorded automatically), user-confirmation-detector (active, resolution signals), smarter-everyday (active, PostToolUse 5-state machine IDLE→ATTEMPTING→TESTING→CANDIDATE→VICTORY). TypeScript L0 quality gate (memory-quality-scorer.ts) runs in-process before Python. store_learning.py via spawnSync argv (QW-01 — no shell). Python L0 gate + 0.85 cosine similarity dedup probe (BGE daemon). Postgres INSERT into archival_memory (1024-dim pgvector). BGE daemon startup race: if daemon not yet warm at invocation time, dedup silently falls back to FTS-only — no embedding, no vector similarity dedup, no logging of the degradation.

Trace 3: Agent edits a hook file → PostToolUse chain → three gaps

Active steps: braintrust_hooks.py (span record) → smarter-everyday (state machine CANDIDATE tracking, async fire-and-forget) → prd-roadmap-sync (no-op for .ts) → git-auto-commit (no-op for repo edits — only fires on ~/.claude edits) → tree-invalidate (marks knowledge-tree stale) → pageindex-watch (no-op for .ts) → import-validator (verifies import paths resolve on disk) → periodic-extract (stochastic). Three gaps: (1) post-edit-diagnostics.ts — source and dist both present, not registered in settings.json; CLAUDE.md claims automatic tsc diagnostics after .ts edits — that claim is false (D2e-02). (2) No hook triggers npm run build after source edit — dist is stale until manually built; four manual steps (edit → build → commit → async sync) with no auto-trigger on any step. (3) audit-braintrust-emits.sh is manual-only — 3 documented incidents of spark agents silently dropping await emitBraintrustScore() calls during multi-file edits; without post-edit auto-audit, regressions surface only if orchestrator manually runs the script after spark exits.

Trace 4: /code-intel query → kill-switch → freshness probe → codegraph → shape validation → Serena hint → TLDR fallback → intel-bus telemetry

10 active steps: code-intel-enforcer (PreToolUse:Grep — default-OFF, wrong matcher, logs zero events) → facade entry (stateless Node CLI, randomUUID correlation_id per call) → bus discovery (fail-open, COORDINATION_SESSION_ID + hashProjectPath; correct fix is explicit --bus or env) → kill-switch check (CCV3_KILLSWITCH → CCV3_CODEGRAPH_OFF → binary-absent → TLDR fallback) → ensureFresh (git rev-parse HEAD vs .indexed-head stamp; dirty files → one full codegraph process per file — root cause of 16-88s median ~62s latency D4b-01) → runCodegraph via process.execPath + [npm-shim.js, ...] (CVE-2024-27980 safe, windowsHide:true, '--' end-of-options separator) → validateCgShape (guards wrong-shaped responses → TLDR fallback) → Serena escalation hint (always emitted on find-symbol; emitted on who-calls when result is empty or name is alias-prone) → TLDR fallback → intel-bus append (JSONL row: ts, facade, specialist, query_type, bus_id, correlation_id, subject_ids as SCIP signature_hashes, corpus_signature). Critical gap (step 11): facade response includes codegraphSubjectIds as proposed_bus_updates — no SubagentStop hook exists to commit them to L2. Bus symbol layer permanently starved.

Key seams: code-intel-enforcer fires on PreToolUse:Grep while facade is invoked via Bash — CLI invocation bypasses enforcer entirely. Freshness probe and bus read are independent — codegraph may sync new content after the bus was read with no cross-check. code-context fuses 3 L3 specialists (tldr + archival recall + codegraph) with no partial-failure rollback — slowest specialist gates the whole response. Multi-session bus discovery: most-recent context.json by mtime selects wrong session bus if multiple Claude Code sessions exist simultaneously.

sections.heading: Target State — L0-L5 Model, Cohesion Metrics, Elegant End-State
sections.body_html:
The L0-L5 layered model with current status against design intent. Target: every layer degrades honestly, CCV3_KILLSWITCH through per-layer env vars short-circuit all consumers, and no always-loaded surface asserts enforcement that has never fired.

  • L0 — Observability (.claude/logs/intel-bus.jsonl) — partial. 125 facade rows, 37 codegraph rows accumulated. Critical gaps: bus_id unknown on 100/125 rows (D1b-05); corr-null 60.7% because correlation_id is a fresh randomUUID per call with zero propagation (D4a-01); intel-bus-stats.mjs Phase E.1 never built → §9 metrics uncomputable (D1A-005). Log rotation: intel-bus.jsonl and all JSONL logs accumulate without bound (OI-4 open; no rotation mechanism).
  • L1 — Substrates (Postgres / codegraph SQLite / .serena / knowledge-tree.json) — done. All substrates live. codegraph platform contract C.1: 12/12 GREEN on Windows 11 / Node 24.4.1. Postgres archival_memory 100+ learnings. knowledge-tree.json per-project via session-start-init-check. Serena MCP available. WAL confirmed active on local NTFS (journalMode:wal).
  • L2 — Context Bus (shared/context-bus.ts, single-writer) — partial. Atomic O_EXCL lock + temp+rename write safety. Intent + files_in_play (partial) write paths wired. focus_symbols and recent_findings: zero production writers — SubagentStop 0 registrations (D10c-01). 158 slow / 14 dropped writes; lock cap leaky 200ms design vs 2293ms observed (D4a-02); CCV3_KILLSWITCH does not short-circuit bus layer as documented (D1A-002); grep_hit written by bus-tool-populator on every Read/Grep but has zero behavioral consumer (D4a-05).
  • L3 — Specialists (8 boundary-defined per .claude/rules/code-intel-boundaries.md) — partial. codegraph LIVE Phase C.2. archival_memory live. PageIndex on-demand only. Serena and ast-grep via MCP (guidance only in facade). Open: codegraph median ~62s in facade (D4b-01); memory 27.4% hit (D9-01); agent-recall-injector 0-for-78 lifetime yield since 2026-05-16 (uv-run startup alone consumes entire 3.5s budget — D2b-03); 30/36 agents memory-blind (D9-04).
  • L4 — Facades (scripts/code-intel.mjs) — partial. Routing correct; codegraph wired; TLDR fallback functional; Serena hints emitted; intel-bus append sound. 45.7% in-facade routing vs ≥80% C.5 gate. Enforcer default-OFF + wrong matcher + zero telemetry. tldr-cli.md (always in context) contradicts boundary contract; Phase B.5 instruction-surface patching never executed (D1A-003). code-intel SKILL.md documents 'codegraph absent' mode while codegraph is LIVE (stale doc — D8c-01).
  • L5 — Orchestrators (Ralph / Maestro / workflow-router) — partial. Ralph core delegation loop functional. Entire spawn pre-hook + agent safety + verification chain dead (D2b-01). SubagentStop unregistered at event level (D10c-01). Three always-loaded docs assert C:10 Maestro blocking that has never fired (D8a-01/D10c-03). plan-to-ralph-enforcer and plan-exit-tracker both active and functional.

§9 Cohesion Metrics (current vs target):

  • Bus utilization rate — target: ≥2 distinct L3 specialists read focus_symbols or files_in_play.load_bearing per agent turn. Current: ~0% (focus_symbols has no writers; bus-focus.ts reads always-empty array TODAY).
  • Cross-specialist chain rate — target: % of /code-intel calls whose correlation_id chain includes ≥2 specialists. Current: 0/125 correlation IDs appear on more than one event; corr-null 60.7% of all rows.
  • Handoff loss — target: ≥80% (SubagentStop writes focus_symbols → next main-context tool dereferences ≥1 symbol). Current: 0% (SubagentStop not registered at event level in repo, active, or template settings).
  • Time-to-correct-tool — target: 1 call via /code-intel facade. Current: 45.7% in-facade (37/81 eligible queries; 44 fell back to TLDR direct; tldr-cli.md actively routes symbol search to TLDR with ~7 direct-call examples).
  • Facade-bypass rate — target: trending to 0 by C.5; enforcer warn-mode accumulates as deny-gate denominator. Current: unmeasurable — enforcer OFF + wrong matcher + zero events logged → denominator has no data; C.5 deny gate never evaluable.
  • Uncorrelated tool-overlap drop — target: trending to 0. Current: unmeasurable — correlation_id not propagated, so correlated escalations (legitimate codegraph→Serena RRF chain) cannot be distinguished from uncorrelated duplicates.

Open issues (5 of 17 most actionable): OI-1 WRRF source weights ({user_mentioned:2.0, serena_lsp:1.5, codegraph_fts:1.0, tldr_ast:1.0, grep_hit:0.3}) have no labeled data basis — validate empirically from 30 days of bus-wrrf.jsonl post-Phase C. OI-2 SCIP IDs cannot survive simultaneous rename+move — moot until focus_symbols has writers. OI-4 log rotation — all JSONL logs accumulate without bound; provisional 100MB threshold sweeping to .claude/logs/archive/ proposed. OI-5 whether PageIndex and Notion Bridge emit to intel-bus — deferred until Phase E validates schema format.

Elegant end-state: a system where the design contract IS the running behavior — single-writer bus with SubagentStop committing sub-agent proposals, lean hot-path with resident recall daemon and synthetic-prompt filter, one canonical getSessionId, one storeLearning(argv) helper, one injectRecall() sanitizer, behavior evidence-locked via §9 facade-bypass counts in intel-bus.jsonl, WRRF weights calibrated from actual telemetry, and zero always-loaded docs asserting enforcement that has never fired.

sections.heading: How We Get There — Sequencing Wave 1 → Structural → Strategic → Deletions
sections.body_html:
Sequencing is gate-driven. Prerequisites must land before their dependents; within a tier, independent items can parallelize.

Wave 1 order:

  1. QW-05, QW-06, QW-07, QW-08, QW-09, QW-11, QW-12 in parallel — all are independent one-field/one-constant/one-rule fixes. No cross-dependencies among these 7. QW-07 (intent-pollution filter) highest priority within this group given 24.6% pollution rate feeding every downstream recall and bus consumer.
  2. QW-04 last in Wave 1 (Agent→Task matcher flip). Gate: QW-01 must have shipped first (done — commit 1788211) because re-enabling agent-error-capture exposes D2d-07/D2d-06 bugs before they are patched. Within QW-04: flip guard/verify hooks first, verify each, then flip inject hooks last. Apply to all 3 settings surfaces atomically or split-brain reforms immediately.
  3. Wave 1 cleanup batch: QW-10 + safe-to-delete deletions (DEL-01, DEL-03, DEL-06, DEL-07, DEL-08). Gate per item: git grep <basename> static-ref-check passes. Also fix D4b-06 (facade PROJECT_DIR process.cwd() fallback) in same change as DEL-01 to prevent tmpclaude recurrence.

Structural arc sequencing (each arc needs own plan+premortem):

  • ST-02 before ST-01: session-id consolidation (ST-02) is prerequisite for SubagentStop writer (ST-01) — the SubagentStop hook needs a canonical id to stamp into proposed_bus_updates; writing with ppid-scheme produces unjoinable rows immediately.
  • ST-01 before SG-04: SubagentStop + bus symbol writer must exist before telemetry joinability program (SG-04) can measure cross-specialist chains. Correlation propagation (ST-01 design work) feeds the §9 denominator.
  • ST-05 before ST-03 and ST-10: resident recall daemon (ST-05) is prerequisite for both UserPromptSubmit parallelization (ST-03 — daemon amortizes the boot-tax that ST-03 parallelizes around) and agent-recall-injector fix (ST-10 — injector currently burns entire 3.5s budget on uv-run startup; daemon eliminates this; ST-10 is also DELICATE per Hook Source Regression history requiring emit-invariant guard + post-spark verification on every edit).
  • ST-04 before C.5 gate flip: codegraph facade latency 35-88s→budget (ST-04, freshness-probe redesign + reindex-budget guarding) is prerequisite for ≥80% facade-adoption gate. At 45.7% in-facade routing with 62s median latency, the C.5 threshold is unreachable without latency fix. QW-04 (reviving agent spawn chain) and Phase B.5 instruction-surface patching (tldr-cli.md update) are co-prerequisites.
  • ST-06 before ST-08: permission layer redesign (ST-06 — remove permission-auto-allow auto-approve ALL behavior) is a precondition for shell-injection argv fixes (ST-08) to provide meaningful safety per Codex cross-model finding. Simultaneously: QW-09 removes hook-auto-execute.md auto-run instruction so the compound bypass is closed at both layers.
  • ST-07 independent: memory sanitizer coverage 2→5 injectors (ST-07) can proceed once ST-02 canonical session-id is stable; does not depend on SubagentStop or daemon work.
  • ST-09 after ST-01: bus lock hardening (ST-09) should follow ST-01 establishing SubagentStop as a new concurrent writer — full lock contention analysis requires all writers registered; the 200ms cap redesign has a different character depending on write frequency from the new writer.

Strategic program order:

  • SG-01 (memory recall floor + corpus health SLO) follows QW-06/QW-07 and ST-05: instrument and re-baseline the 27.4% hit rate after the math fixes and daemon land; define a measurable hit-rate SLO and recurring health-check cadence.
  • SG-02 (3-way settings/template drift) can start in parallel with Wave 1: establish source-of-truth enforcement for the 18 hooks missing from tracked repo; extend /sync-drift skill with drift-detection gate; reconcile bootstrap template (still registers navigator-safety, the deregistered safety-inversion hook).
  • SG-03 (elegance/pruning program) owns operator-confirm deletion items (DEL-02, DEL-05 two-step, DEL-09 sync-config-first, DEL-10 grep-verify, DEL-11 doc-scrub, DEL-12 per-item-grep) plus named duplication cluster consolidations. Execute after Wave 1 repo hygiene stabilizes; never batch safe_to_delete:false items with trivial deletes.
  • SG-04 (telemetry joinability + intel-bus consumer) is the terminal tier: depends on ST-02 (canonical id) + ST-01 (correlation propagation). Build intel-bus-stats.mjs, weekly digest owner, metadata.bus_snapshot memory bridge; recalibrate WRRF weights from 30 days of bus-wrrf.jsonl; re-examine codex-lift ROI once accepted/rejected disposition is tracked per row.

C.5 deny-flip gate conditions (all three must be green): (1) in-facade routing ≥80% measured in actual intel-bus.jsonl (requires ST-04 latency fix + Phase B.5 instruction-surface patching + QW-04 reviving agent spawn chain to increase facade invocations); (2) code-intel-enforcer switched from default-OFF to warn-mode, wrong matcher corrected, telemetry flowing; (3) intel-bus-stats.mjs built and computing §9 metrics so the denominator is real data, not zero. Only after all three: flip to deny-mode and the facade-bypass rate becomes an enforced invariant.
